lockedLead: The credentials of the workspaces on this device are encrypted with the app password. Without it, connections with an entered key or password cannot be opened.
setupLead: This system has no keyring in which WireTerm could store its key{reason}. Entered keys and passwords are therefore encrypted with an app password that is asked for at every start.
setupWarning: Whoever forgets the app password can no longer get at these credentials. An export with its own password is the backup for that.
unavailableLead: The key for the credentials on this device is in the system keyring, but the keyring is not answering right now{reason}. If it is locked, it usually helps to unlock it and then try again.
unavailableHint: Without it everything else carries on; only entered keys and passwords stay locked until then.
